baseline_step_model.description: Multiplicative log-scale baseline activity model. Brisson percentage effects are encoded as log effects.

recovery_class_probability_model.description: Class-probability logit shifts around configured six-class priors. Pain effects are allowed here because Duong found baseline pain differed across trajectory groups.

default_wearable.description: Balanced wearable/smartphone missingness with isolated days, short gaps, long gaps, MNAR-like burden-related nonwear, and dropout.

device_failure.explanation: Battery, sensor, app crash, firmware, or device malfunction.

dropout.explanation: Permanent or semi-permanent disengagement from device/data collection.

forgot_or_nonwear.explanation: Forgetting to wear, carry, charge, or sync the wearable/phone.

pain_fatigue_or_burden_related_nonwear.explanation: Pain, fatigue, disrupted routines, low motivation, or recovery burden.

sleep_or_low_wear_time.explanation: Invalid wear-time, rest days, or insufficient waking wear time.

sync_or_connectivity_problem.explanation: Phone sync, Bluetooth, internet, permissions, or app background restrictions.

high_missingness_sensitivity.description: Higher missingness burden for sensitivity analyses.

low_missingness_sensitivity.description: Lower missingness burden for sensitivity analyses.

age.source: Duong TKR sample mean/SD, with wider simulation clipping.

baseline_function_score.source: Assumed for post-treatment simulator; higher means better function.

digital_confidence_score.source: Duong modified Computer Self-efficacy Scale mean/SD.

osteoarthritis_severity.source: Brisson KL distribution and TKR context; shifted toward severe/end-stage.

decrease_then_increase.duong_mapping: Main surgical recovery pattern; mostly low gradually increasing plus some high rapidly increasing.

decreasing.duong_mapping: Clinically plausible one-year extrapolation; not a dominant Duong 12-week group.

fluctuating_or_relapsing.duong_mapping: Part of low gradually increasing group extrapolated to unstable year-long recovery.

increase_then_decrease.duong_mapping: One-year relapse/decline extrapolation added for later complications or motivation loss.

increasing.duong_mapping: High rapidly increasing group plus part of high gradually increasing group.

stable_baseline.duong_mapping: Mostly high and gradually increasing group split into stable one-year outcome.
